issues.reason: Categorical statements is explicit that a bare (Member <group> <prop>) says the group-as-object is P and that a copular predicate on a plural always goes through the distributive rule, so (Member sk_group_1 hopeful) is the reading the instruction set forbids.

The preposition-named oblique must be "the preposition actually used" and never a coined synonym head; "our preference IS TO achieve" contains no "for", so (For …) is an unlicensed head (the licensed (For <noun> <arg>) cases — "the search for the heir" — all have the word in the text).

Sealing licenses "a single atom as itself" as the term argument, and the achieve event's atoms outside it are the occurrence-neutral non-finite-complement reification plus VP-ellipsis coreference ("do so"), so nothing false or over-asserted results.

"remain" falls in the gap the reviewer registers (no continuative-copular operator, and Still renders only the particle "still"), and an omission over otherwise true, well-typed atoms is not a defect under the calibration line.

"chief executive Marce Fuller" is the lowercase common noun beside a capitalized name, which Names and casing routes to "one ordinary type atom" (the Brindle estuary case), not to the copular-tense subsection's comma-set appositive; every worked past VERBAL clause emits its referent typing atoms bare (A welder checked the seam; the courier; the train).

gaps_confirmed: direct quotation as the complement of a speech verb — the attitude section covers finite that-clauses only, and says nothing about a verbatim quote
specificational copular with an infinitival complement ("our preference is to achieve X") — no encoding for "N is to V"
continuative copular verbs ("remain / stay ADJ") — no operator for the continuation and no reification trigger
an adjective with a finite clausal complement ("hopeful (that) we can do so") — only an adjective's PP complement is covered
first- and second-person pronouns ("our", "we") — the anonymous-witness rule classes he/she/it/they only, and nothing licenses linking the speaker into a "we" group
new_gaps: the dual-emit flat half of a copular state has no licensed form INSIDE a seal when the subject is a plural: the prescribed distribution rule is an (Implication …), which cannot sit as an ordinary conjunct of a sealed (And …), so the flat atom can only be dropped

Removed (For sk_preference_1 sk_achieve_1), the head coined from a preposition absent from the text, leaving the preference-to-action link unrecorded as the registered gap.
